catalog_quote: water craft akála – outrigger canoe akála aapa [kala:pa] in allegro speech ... mast maleerra The /ee/ here represents [malæ:ra]; primary word stress is on V2. ... FI is a language whose morphophonology is very much built for managing modulations of speed of utterance. It may be said that the language is also built for speed per se. Allegro speech reduces word length, largely via vowel deletions, transforms vowels into corresponding glides, and inserts dummy C(V) segments to avoid possible V+V sequences across word boundaries (external sandhi).
